environment.description: Kubernetes CronJob running in namespace 'batch-jobs'. The pod mounts an NFS volume from a shared upload server where external users can deposit CSV files. The pgBouncer instance at db-pooler.internal:6432 is configured in session mode (pool_mode=session) to support prepared statements and extended query protocol. The 'batch_processor' PostgreSQL role has UPDATE and INSERT privileges on 'accounts' and 'audit_log' tables. No input sanitization middleware or query firewall is deployed between the application and pgBouncer.

config.db_role_privileges: UPDATE on accounts, INSERT on audit_log, INSERT on processed_files
config.input_source: NFS mount from shared upload server, writable by external users
config.network_policy: allow all egress from batch-jobs namespace
